dedupe_keys.name: cicv5g 5g communication delay dataset for cloud based vehicle planning and control

description: CICV5G records communication delays for connected vehicles at Tongji University's intelligent vehicle evaluation base. The research team publishes more than 150,000 vehicle-to-network-to-vehicle transmission cycles covering urban, arterial, rural and off-road scenarios on private n8 and public n78 networks. Each cycle links round-trip delay with vehicle position, heading, velocity, cell identity and radio signal indicators. The repository describes 20 Hz as the principal sampling rate, with additional 10, 33 and 100 Hz experiments; campaign calendar dates are not specified in its README. Data are UTF-8, whitespace-separated text tables, accompanied by Python analysis tools, on GitHub and in a Zenodo archive. Both the Zenodo metadata and README state CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. The Zenodo description calls its data a representative sample, whereas the paper describes a complete archive; the catalogue therefore does not promise identical completeness across locations. These measured delays can calibrate communication models and test vehicle-control resilience during weak coverage. They could complement model-sumo in a coupled traffic and network simulation, after the user supplies the coupling code.
